correctness.rationale: Checked RESULT.md §§Proof and Verification and the supporting sources and recorded outputs. For a pair X,Y use the direct-sum blocks for their intersection, their complementary parts, and the complement of their sum. Incomparability with both incomparable X,Y is witnessed by the span of x+y with x in X outside Y and y in Y outside X, even over F2. For X<Y an outside-Y line witnesses incomparability with both exactly when X is nonzero and Y proper. Other third-move cases follow by strict intervals, lines and dual superspaces; the incomparable super-X case needs either one direction outside X+Y or at least two independent directions from Y modulo X∩Y. In the incomparable row, the tests p+u≥2 and p+v≥2 use p only as zero versus positive because u,v>0. So the collection of pair types for a fixed X uses only the possible (p>0,min(u,2)) and (w>0,min(v,2)) along the two splits; those split profiles stabilize at dimension and codimension 3. The pointed rank-at-most-two chain formulas detect both clips exactly, including the four-element chain whose two one-quantifier clauses share their middle element. Thus rank three detects precisely the set of available clips, distinct for dimensions 1–5 and constant from 6. Counting RREFs by pivot set gives a polynomial in field size with nonnegative coefficients, and embedding into a higher dimension strictly increases the count. The binary dimension-six Gaussian coefficients sum to 2825, the sharp uniform representative bound in the finite-field subfamily. This is an analytic all-fields check; the finite outputs were inspected, not run or used as the infinite proof.
